scope.H: all DFS-enumerated binary monic constant-one H with binary H(x^3)H(x^5)
scope.factor_domain: rational monic factor allocations from the SymPy QQ factor-list backend

exactness: Support DFS, factor-product checks, substitutions, and negative witnesses use exact integer arithmetic. Search and verifier are separate programs and both actually ran.
factorization_boundary: Completeness depends on SymPy 1.14.0 factor_list/Poly.is_irreducible over QQ. No independent irreducibility certificate has been accepted for this archive. A separate generation job is still running and is not mathematical evidence here.
claim_boundary: No signed rational allocation in this bounded backend-dependent ledger had both crossed substitutions nonnegative. This does not cover arbitrary real factors, degrees outside 18..24, or prove P31. Degrees 18..19 are retained as a computation check only; the new exploration emphasis is 21..24.
